validation_policy: Software-only acceptance per explicit user instruction. Physical hardware tests are excluded; software results do not imply physical validation. Every release must pass a fresh image build, QEMU boot and complete artifact verification.
migration: Rust/GTK4/Wayland. Native development release v0.6.0-dev.1 was published and independently checked. Direct provider modules and their Windows session adapter are removed from the current scope. Physical hardware and Windows-testhost acceptance are excluded. Regular-release parity remains open.
